_locked: 2026-05-09 (expansion to all 4 bins for Battery LOO co-primary)

_history.purpose: R1 leakage exclusion + conditional secondary Battery LOO

_history.scope: all 4 bins (34 batteries: 7 demographic + 10 behavioral + 2 psychological + 15 attitudinal)
_history.purpose: R1 leakage exclusion + UNCONDITIONAL co-primary Battery LOO with nested Holm correction across 4 bin-families

_purpose: Maps GSS variables to construct-level batteries. Used by (a) R1 leakage exclusion in the primary 4-bin LOO; (b) Battery LOO co-primary analysis with nested Holm correction.
_design_principles: A battery groups variables that measure the SAME UNDERLYING CONSTRUCT closely enough that a Battery LOO must drop them together.
SPLIT criterion: split when sub-construct, target, time point, or response scale differs sufficiently to conflate distinct signals.
Items NOT listed in any battery are 'singletons' — R1 is a no-op for them; they are NOT included in Battery LOO testing.
Locked decisions (Joyce 2026-05-08): R3 NOT implemented; R1 is the structural defense; R2 (regression baseline) provides the partition test.
_holm_correction: Nested Holm-Bonferroni at α=0.05 separately within each bin's battery family. Demographic family (n=7), Behavioral family (n=10), Psychological family (n=2), Attitudinal family (n=15). Joint Holm across all 34 was rejected because (a) bin is a meaningful pre-registered boundary; (b) joint Holm at n=34 would force the psychological 2-battery family to clear α/34=0.0015, which is impractical.

own_education.construct: Respondent's own educational attainment (years completed + highest degree).

parental_education.construct: Parental educational attainment (both parents, both years and degree). Single battery for 'family-of-origin SES' construct; not split by parent gender (assortative mating + co-residence make father's and mother's education tightly correlated).

marital_status.construct: Current marital position: status + type + widowhood history.

racial_ethnic_origin.construct: Racial / ethnic identity + nativity. Lumped because in 2024 GSS these are highly correlated and form one identity construct.

family_of_origin_economic.construct: Age-16 family economic position (family income at 16 + dwelling ownership at 16). NOTE: INCOME16 (current family income) is a singleton, NOT in this battery — different time point.

growing_up_geography.construct: Geographic context of growing up: region at 16 + mobility since 16.

growing_up_family_structure.construct: Family structure at age 16: living arrangement + reason if not with parents.

current_religious_intensity.construct: Current religious practice intensity: attendance + prayer frequency + affiliation strength + fundamentalism. Likert/frequency-flavored scales. Split from denominational_identity because that is categorical denomination (different scale + sub-construct).

denominational_identity.construct: Religious denomination labels (current + raised in). Categorical scale, distinct from intensity.

voting_turnout.construct: Did respondent vote (binary)? 2016 + 2020. Split from voting_choice because turnout (binary) and choice (categorical) are different scales + sub-constructs.

voting_choice.construct: Whom did respondent vote for (categorical)? 2016 + 2020. Split from voting_turnout per scale + sub-construct.

current_employment.construct: Current work load: labor force status + hours last week + part-time/full-time.

work_history.construct: Work history: ever-worked + ever-unemployed (last 10 years). Both binary, both retrospective.

job_security_perception.construct: Subjective labor-market security: likelihood of losing job + ease of finding equivalent. Likert subjective perception, distinct from current_employment (objective) and work_history (factual retrospective).

traditional_media.construct: Traditional broadcast/print media exposure: TV hours + newspaper frequency.

digital_media.construct: Digital media usage: computer use + mobile internet. Split from traditional_media because medium type (broadcast vs digital) defines distinct sub-construct.

gun_related.construct: Gun-culture participation behaviors: gun ownership + hunting activity (self or spouse/partner).

subjective_wellbeing.construct: GSS classic satisfaction/wellbeing battery — general happiness + marital happiness + job satisfaction + life-as-experience evaluation. Same Likert family across 4 life domains.

interpersonal_trust.construct: GSS classic 'trust triad' — three items measuring generalized social trust (people fair / helpful / trustworthy). Same scale, same construct.

abortion.construct: Conditions under which legal abortion should be available. All 7 items are binary YES/NO and share canonical 1972-onward GSS wording.

confidence_in_institutions.construct: Institutional confidence battery — same 3-point Likert scale (great deal / only some / hardly any) across all 13 institutions.

national_priorities.construct: Spending priority battery — same 3-point scale (too little / about right / too much) across all 15 domains.

racial_inequality_perception.construct: Causes-of-racial-inequality + group-wealth-attribution + affirmative-action-perception. Tightly correlated cluster covering the same construct (perceived racial inequality).

gender_role_attitudes.construct: Gender-role attitudes battery — same 4-point agree/disagree scale on 5 gender-role propositions.

civil_lib_atheists.construct: Civil-liberty extension to anti-religionists (free speech + teaching).

civil_lib_racists.construct: Civil-liberty extension to racists (free speech + teaching + library access).

civil_lib_communists.construct: Civil-liberty extension to communists (free speech + employment + library access).

sexual_morality.construct: Same 4-point ALWAYS/NOT WRONG scale on extramarital and same-sex relations.

moral_legalization.construct: Should-be-legal stance on marijuana and pornography — both are 'should the state regulate this?' items.

adolescent_sex_policy.construct: Adolescent sex policy — birth-control access for teens + sex-education in schools.

religious_belief.construct: Personal religious / spiritual belief intensity (5 distinct measures of the same latent).

economic_help.construct: Government redistribution + economic-mobility beliefs. Tightly correlated 'redistribution attitude' cluster.

police_use_of_force.construct: When may police strike a citizen? — three scenarios with same 1-2 scale.
